<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" data-expandtext="Book 3 — reveal" data-collapsetext="Hide">
== Ozma of Oz / A Record of Her Adventures with Dorothy Gale of Kansas, the Yellow Hen, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, Tiktok, the Cowardly Lion, and the Hungry Tiger; Besides Other Good People too Numerous to Mention Faithfully Recorded Herein ==

The Chief Steward, also known as the Steward, attends the King's court and manages the reception of guests. When the King claps his hands to summon him after a guessing game leaves a visitor turned into an ornament, the Steward is ordered to show the newly arrived guests to their sleeping apartments. He leads Dorothy through a long hall to the first sleeping room, then settles the Scarecrow and Tiktok in the next room and the Lion and the Tiger in the third, before leaving them for the night. He wears a heavy gold chain around his neck as a mark of office, which seems to indicate that his post is held under the Nome King.
